reviews.review_description:
Soccer Punch is definitely different among other soccer games, it’s a punch in the gut, but in the best way! 😂

The animal characters, awesome elemental visuals, and fast-paced gameplay make it surprisingly fun and addictive. The special powers and unexpected surprises along the way keep every run exciting, and the AI opponents can be challenging but that’s what makes it fun! You can keep trying, improve your skills, and collect those trophies. 🏆

Whether you play solo or with friends in multiplayer, Soccer Punch is a competitive and entertaining VR game that even a non-soccer fan like me can enjoy!

Definitely worth a try… Highly recommended 🙌🏻

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for the amazing review! 🙌🏻

I’m really happy you enjoyed the craziness of Soccer Punch, the powers, animals, surprises, and competitive side are exactly what I wanted to make fun. 😄⚽
And hearing that even a non-soccer fan can enjoy it means a lot!

Thanks again for playing and supporting the game. 🏆🔥

reviews.review_description:
If you crave fast-paced, arcade-style soccer that delivers instant thrills, Soccer Punch is your game! This VR powerhouse captures the nostalgic magic of classic Match Day on Amstrad CPC but cranks it up to a more modern polish version. The animations are razor-sharp, the gameplay is blisteringly quick, and the execution is flawless—every volley, tackle, and last-ditch clearance feels weighty and responsive.

Whether you're dueling AI in solo sprints, tackling a soccer adventure mode, or trash-talking friends in multiplayer, the replayability is sky-high. Bonus items add strategic depth, but the real magic lies in mastering the controls—a well-placed volley in front of the keeper? Pure gold. A direct shot? Risky business. This is soccer stripped down to its most addictive essence: fast, fun, and endlessly playable.

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for this amazing review! 🙌⚽⚡

I’m really happy you enjoyed the fast-paced arcade feeling of Soccer Punch. One of my main goals was to make the game easy to jump into and immediately fun, while still giving players enough depth to improve their timing, positioning, volleys, and overall strategy.

It’s also great to hear that you enjoyed the different modes and the bonus items. I wanted those elements to keep matches unpredictable and give players different ways to approach each game, whether playing solo, going through Adventure mode, or competing in multiplayer.

Your comment about the volleys especially made me smile, because that’s exactly the kind of satisfying moment I wanted the game to create taking the risk, getting the timing right, and landing that perfect shot! 😄

As a solo developer, feedback like this really means a lot and motivates me to keep improving Soccer Punch and adding more polish and content.

Thank you again for playing, for taking the time to write such a detailed review, and for supporting the game! 🏆⚡⚽

reviews.review_description:
I haven't played it for long yet but found the little characters fun and love how there are different modes of play.
The game play is fast with definite skills needed to complete life like shots and volleys for example 
I'm sure it will become one of my favourite with the animated characters having such personality😀

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for your lovely review! 😃 I'm really happy you're enjoying the little characters and the different game modes! I put a lot of love into giving each character its own personality, so it means a lot to hear that. Hope you have many more fun matches ahead! ⚽🎮

reviews.review_title: JUST LIKE FIFA BUT MUCH CUTER PLAYERS
reviews.review_description:
There is no Harry Kane or Jude Bellingham but what we have is Leo the Lion & his lion mates (I called him Leon btw)

Presenttation is incredible, it’s looks surperb.
I was not expecting this to look and play so well.
I was involved in a 9-9 match it was end to end, can tbe dev add penalties to decide the winner please.

Tackling, passing and shooting is very straightforward, I wasn’t sure about tapping A as I gave the opponents two goals and also had a goal ruled out…..VAR maybe.

The whole game is just so cute and a joy to play.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much! ⚽🦁❤️ Leon it is! 😄 I’m really happy you enjoyed the presentation and the fast arcade gameplay. A 9–9 match sounds absolutely crazy! Penalties to decide a draw is a great idea , definitely something I’ll look into for a future update. Thanks for playing and for the awesome feedback! 👊⚽

reviews.review_description: What a lovely game, a brilliant bit of fun that puts a whole new spin on football. Really well done, vibrant clear graphics and lots of scope for replayability with adventure (against AI) duel and multiplayer.  Well done devs

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much! ⚽💥 
I’m really happy you’re enjoying Soccer Punch and its arcade take on football! 
Thanks for playing and for the amazing support! ❤️
